SENSORS & FAILSAFE RELAY

Collected: PM2.5, PM10, NO₂, CO, SO₂, temperature and humidity.
Blue routes: high-traffic patrols.
Green routes: industrial-zone patrols.
Emergency RF Telemetry: 5 ground monitoring stations positioned along patrol corridors maintain overlapping radio coverage (4.5 km radius per station; 2.2 km drone transceiver radius). If a drone experiences a mid-scan failure, cached air-quality packets automatically transmit via radio wave to the nearest station, which forwards telemetry over terrestrial cellular broadband.
Coverage Margin: 100% of active flight corridors remain inside overlapping station radio wave and cellular backhaul footprints.
